B07HM6L48C.title: Lutron Caseta 3-Way Smart Dimmer Kit; LED Dimmer, Wireless Remote & Bracket
bullets: ADD A NEW SWITCH ANYWHERE: Add a new switch location anywhere in under 15 minutes. Simply replace the existing light switch with the Caseta dimmer and mount the Pico remote anywhere you'd like to control the lights. Pico fits in a standard wallplate to blend in with other switches

MOST CONNECTED SMART LIGHTING: The Caseta Lutron smart switch connects with Alexa, Apple HomeKit, Google Home, Ring, and more—making it one of the most compatible smart switches available (Lutron Hub required)
RELIABLY SMART CONNECTION: The Lutron Smart Hub works without Wi-Fi, providing ultra-fast, reliable performance beyond a typical wifi switch for dependable smart lighting

CONTROL WITH THE LUTRON APP: Manage your smart light switch from anywhere with the Lutron app; control your Lutron switches with scenes, scheduling, geofencing, smart-away, and timers for a complete smart home automation (Lutron Hub required)
CASETA ORIGINAL AESTHETIC: The Lutron Caseta dimmer switch features a sleek, modern design that blends with existing light switches, delivering a premium dimming experience.

REMOTE CONTROL WITH PICO: Use the Lutron Pico remote to wirelessly control your smart dimmer switch devices anywhere. Mount flush against a wall, over top of a junction box, or keep on a nightstand or side table
ANYONE CAN INSTALL: No neutral required; this Lutron Caseta smart dimmer switch installs in as little as 15 minutes

MAKE YOUR LIGHTS SMART: One Lutron Caseta switch can turn multiple lights or fixtures into a smart dimmer light switch system. This dimmable light switch works with existing bulbs—no need for smart bulbs—making it ideal for smart lighting
TECHNICAL PERFORMANCE: This Lutron Caseta dimmer switch works with up to 150W LED and 600W incandescent/halogen, making it a versatile smart switch dimmer for most home lighting setups
Includes: (1) Caseta smart dimmer switch (interruptor inteligente), (1) Pico 3-button remote, and (1) Pico wall plate bracket; wallplate sold separately

B00JJY1QG0.title: Lutron Caseta Smart Lamp Dimmer Kit; Plug-In Dimmer & Pico Wireless Remote
bullets: ADD A SWITCH TO YOUR LAMPS: Avoid walking through a dark room to turn your lamps on or off. Simply plug the lamp into the lamp dimmer/switch and put the Pico remote at the entrance of the room. Perfect for bedrooms with nightstand lamps or living rooms that have lamps

WIRELESS CONTROL: Pico remote can mount flush against the wall or in a j-box using the included adapter and fits inside a standard wallplate. Can also put on a side table, coffee table or island for easy control of your lights
DIMMER OR SWITCH: Plug-in dimmer can be changed into "switch mode" with simple button press programming, if you are not looking to dim your lights.

SMART EXPANSION: Add a Lutron Caseta Hub to control with the app or through Alexa, Apple Home, Google Assistant, Ring, or other home assistants. With the Caseta Hub, you can set schedules or scenes through the app

PEACE OF MIND: Always come back to a well-lit home with the smart Lutron dimmer switch; enable Smart Away to randomly turn your lights on/off so it looks like you’re home even when away, using this dimmable light switch (Caseta Smart Hub required)
SMART CONTROL OF PLUG-IN LAMPS: This light dimmer switch plug in plugs into a standard outlet and can be used with up to two table or floor lamps
KIT INCLUDES: The kit includes (1) Lutron Caseta plug-in LED dimmer switch for lamps; coordinating accessories sold separately

Includes: (1) Pico remote for fan speed control; fan speed control (PD-FSQN-XX required) and accessories sold separately
